static_checks.message: Pipeline review must use the current native ClosePlan reader
Must include the Native Qualification status column
Must distinguish native read, pending, and unavailable states
Pipeline action must use exact question-level evidence rather than arithmetic gaps
Must define the portfolio sort order
Must not show a legacy local qualification total
Must not rank deals by legacy required-minus-current arithmetic
Missing native data must never become zero
Pursuit review must not retain the legacy writer

evals.expected_behavior: Produces one row per active pursuit with operational fields and a live Native Qualification read/pending/unavailable status; uses exact native question evidence needs and never substitutes local scores or arithmetic gaps
assertions: Reads every active pursuit across accounts and keeps rows whose native state is missing or unavailable
Deduplicates Opportunity IDs before running the exact native JSON reader and associates results back to pursuit rows
Table includes Deal, Account, Stage, Gate, Days, Native Qualification, SF Stage, SF Close Date, Evidence Need, and Next Action
A complete selected native read is labeled read without implying pass; ambiguity or missing metadata is pending; auth, not-found, missing linkage, and incomplete reads are unavailable
Evidence Need cites an exact unanswered question ID or a status reason, not a locally calculated numeric gap
Rows are sorted in reverse funnel order and followed by read, pending, unavailable, timing-risk, and staleness summaries

evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes the pursuit-review trigger and runs the native-status portfolio review in read-only mode
assertions: Recognizes the request as a pursuit review and scans all active pursuits
Reports Native Qualification read, pending, or unavailable for every row
Does not present historical local values as current qualification and performs no writes

evals.prompt: show my pipeline even though one deal has no ClosePlan and another returned incomplete questions
evals.expected_behavior: Keeps both deals visible, labels Native Qualification unavailable with distinct reasons, and does not replace either condition with zero, a pass, or historical local state
assertions: The no-ClosePlan row remains present and says unavailable because no native scorecard is linked
The incomplete row remains present and includes the reader issues or incomplete collection reason
Neither row receives an invented native value, qualification verdict, or arithmetic evidence gap
Next actions request linkage or a complete reread rather than a score write
